SA
Salman Ali

Full-Stack Developer · Lahore, Pakistan

I turn ideas into software that looks good, works well, and holds up beyond launch.

I’m a passionate full-stack developer focused on scalable, high-performance, user-friendly web applications. My experience spans business websites, CRM systems, healthcare platforms, AI applications, Web3 projects, and dashboards.

I work across frontend and backend development, database architecture, authentication, third-party APIs, responsive design, technical SEO, and performance optimization. I also handle the work that keeps products moving: debugging, Git collaboration, deployment, and maintenance.
